description: Draft a Bags token launch with VaultBags preconfigured, for a person to finish and sign. Give the token's name, ticker and description (and optionally a website and an X account); get back a link to the VaultBags launcher with those fields filled in, and the steps the person takes next. Text only: from here nothing can be signed or spent, and the image, the fee share, any initial buy and every signature stay with the person, in their own wallet. A field that breaks the launch rules is refused with the reason. The text you send is shown to the person as written; they review it before anything happens.

description.description: What the token is, 1 to 1000 characters.

symbol.description: Ticker, 1 to 10 letters or digits (a leading $ is dropped).

twitter.description: Optional X handle or profile address.

name: prepare_token_launch
